1.why: src/R.cpp:62 and 72, maxPoly loops over getChannels and getPolyVoltage reads the channel

comment: The AS output compounds across polyphonic channels: `as` is computed once before the channel loop and then multiplied by each channel's output inside it (src/R.cpp:66 and 73), so channel 0 carries the knob level times the output, channel 1 carries that times its own output, and so on. Channel 0 is the only one that behaves as the panel implies. Both knobs use the maker's centred dB scaling, two to the power minus two to the minus power over -1 to 1, which is zero at the centre and plus and minus one and a half at the ends (src/R.cpp:46-47 and 51-53). The panel prints ON, AS, IN, ON, AS and OUT.
